description: Pick a file (OS open dialog) → outputs its path (val-path) and data URL (val-data, e.g. for Analyse).
instructions:
Pick a file from disk via the OS open dialog (the picker UI is rendered by the app). Publishes the chosen file's name on `val-path` (browsers don't expose the absolute path) and its data URL (`data:<mime>;base64,…`) on `val-data`.

TIP: wire `val-data` into an Analyse node's File input to send the bytes to Gemini; wire `val-path` into an Output / Text node to record the filename. The data URL is transient (not written into saved flows).
